programme.desc: Lifeguards lay down the law after a woman reports being spat on at Bondi Beach.

programme.title: S08 E04 - Dead and Breakfast
programme.desc: Owners of the Thomas House in Red Boiling Springs, Tennessee believe that some former residents may never have left.

programme.title: S08 E05 - Moonshine & Madness
programme.desc: Jason Hawes, along with the members of The Atlantic Paranormal Society, investigates paranormal activities inside Graham Mansion in Virginia.

programme.title: S08 E06 - City Hell
programme.desc: TAPS investigates claims that the city hall in Providence, R.I., is haunted by a former mayor; a child is traumatized by spirits at his grandparents' home.
